name: Frostwhisper Gorge
summary: In southern Winterspring, Frostwhisper Gorge runs just north of Darkwhisper Gorge. Ancient night elven ruins lie across its icy floor and cliffs, now held by Frostmaul giants. A lone dwarf camp overlooks the ocean from the eastern rim.

sections.title: A Frozen Chasm of Ruins and Giants
sections.body: Frostwhisper Gorge cuts through Winterspring's southern mountains, just north of Darkwhisper Gorge. Snow covers the ravine floor and cliff ridges, where stonework from ancient night elven settlements remains. Frostmaul giants and their preservers claim the gorge now. They fiercely defend its frozen crags, making travel into the ravine perilous.

sections.title: The Eastern Overlook
sections.body: A narrow, quiet track leads to a small outpost atop the gorge's eastern cliffs. Travelers flying by wyvern or gryphon between Azshara, Orgrimmar, and Winterspring may spot it from above. An Ironforge banner marks the solitary dwarven camp at the cliff's edge. Crates of provisions, barrels of ale, a comfortable chair, and a rifle leaning against its rest sit there. The camp overlooks the drop to the Great Sea below.

faq.q: What creatures live in Frostwhisper Gorge?
faq.answer: Frostmaul giants and Frostmaul Preservers inhabit the canyon floor and its surrounding terraces.
Frostwhisper Gorge cuts through southern Winterspring's icy cliffs, just north of Darkwhisper Gorge.

faq.q: What is the small dwarf camp on the eastern cliffs?
faq.answer: A solitary dwarven campsite on the eastern ridge flies an Ironforge banner. It has a chair, a rifle, crates of provisions, and barrels of ale. The camp looks over the cliff toward the sea.

faq.q: Are there night elf ruins down in the gorge?
faq.answer: Yes. Ancient night elven pillars and stonework lie across the gorge floor and upper cliff ridges, remnants of old Kaldorei habitations.

angles.text: High on the chasm's eastern rim, a dwarf traveler has made camp. An Ironforge banner, a rifle, and plenty of ale are there, overlooking the ocean.
Ancient night elven structures lie in the gorge's snowy depths, where Frostmaul giants now prowl.
